text:
This compliance narrative summarizes the structured quality reporting records supplied for measure HAPI-02 and measure READM-30. No benchmark, target, threshold, or compliance determination was included in the source records; therefore, the narrative is limited to the reported measure elements.

For HAPI-02, “Hospital-acquired pressure injury rate,” the reporting period is 2026-Q1 and the unit is percent. The record reports a numerator of 225, a denominator of 1274, and exclusions of 32. The reported rate is 18.12 percent. The event dates listed for this measure are 2026-01-19, 2026-05-17, 2026-05-19, 2026-06-27, and 2026-12-07. These values represent the complete structured data provided for this measure record.

For READM-30, “30-day all-cause readmission rate,” the reporting period is 2026-Q2 and the unit is percent. The record reports a numerator of 76, a denominator of 1033, and exclusions of 33. The reported rate is 7.6 percent. The event dates listed for this measure are 2026-02-10, 2026-05-05, 2026-06-26, 2026-09-17, and 2026-12-02. These values represent the complete structured data provided for this measure record.

Based on the supplied records, the organization has documented measure identifiers, measure names, reporting periods, units, numerators, denominators, exclusions, reported rates, and event date lists for both quality measures. The records do not include additional stratification, rationale for exclusions, validation notes, performance targets, or corrective action information. Accordingly, this narrative supports a factual reporting summary of the submitted measure data without adding interpretation beyond the structured fields provided.
